label: PREVIEW v0.9 simulator, synthetic fleet, behaviour not validated
status_quo: ScheduledPolicy scheduled/1.0.0 at every 08:00 IST decision epoch, no extra orders
treatment: ScheduledPolicy scheduled/1.0.0 + the orders below, issued at the epoch

selected_demand.job_text: REPLACE BRAKE PARACHUTE DUE TO HI-TIME (45 STREAMINGS).
selected_demand.why: oldest open AOG demand whose job is still open and is the U/S (grounding) entry of the latest TECH_LOG record; older 'open' AOG demands in the consumer view belong to closed jobs (stale or lagged supply records, a deliberate data-quality defect)

belief.mode_note: IN-LOOP what-if: hidden state resampled from observations by the data layer's reference SurvivalPosterior (PROXY A-W1.8-23), then run as ensemble member m. See README for what it does and does not resample.

ensemble.mode_note: OFFLINE evaluation: the TRUE snapshot state (privileged) with ensemble member m's exogenous future; not available to a deployed product.

kpi_definitions.mc: mission-capable fraction of equipment-in-service time in the window (NAMP SCIR, from AVAILABILITY_STATE bins)
kpi_definitions.nmcs: fraction of time not mission capable, supply
kpi_definitions.nmcm: fraction of time not mission capable, maintenance (scheduled + unscheduled)
kpi_definitions.nmcd: fraction of time not mission capable, depot
kpi_definitions.flown_fh: flight hours flown in the window
kpi_definitions.man_hours: man-hours booked on jobs closed in the window
kpi_definitions.cost: RELATIVE cost proxy (A-W1.8-11): new spares + 0.3 x unit cost per depot repair + man-hours x mh_cost + expedite premiums; unitless, not money
kpi_definitions.in_flight_failures: defects first reported from the air (WD-AIR / WD-ABT)
